description: OLE-UPDATE visibility across processes: process A opens a read/write Connection and four read-only Recordsets of 'SELECT ID, Code, Txt FROM Items' (server keyset, server static, server dynamic, client static), reads row 1 Txt and the properties Others' Changes Visible, Own Changes Visible and Remove Deleted Rows; process B then UPDATEs row 1, INSERTs a row and DELETEs row 2 through its own Connection and closes. A reads each Recordset without refreshing (Value, UnderlyingValue, RecordCount, next row), then Resync(adAffectAll, adResyncAllValues), then Requery with RecordCount and all rows. Asks which cursor types see another process's update, insert and delete and when.
retentionNote: Designed r-oledb-odbc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
